info.name: Portcast Container Tracking Augmentation Tracking Upload API

items.docs: Start tracking an ocean container. Provide the container number, the carrier SCAC code (or AUTO), and optionally the master bill of lading / booking number and an HTTPS callback_url for Push updates. Returns the created bill-of-lading bookmark including the bookmark id used to fetch tracking data.

info.name: Upload using Booking / Bill of Lading

items.docs: Start tracking using a booking or bill of lading number without a container number; Portcast discovers the containers on the document. Returns discovered containers, booking details, locations, vessels, and the resolved route.

params.name: bookmark_id
params.description: The bill-of-lading bookmark id returned by an upload call.

items.docs: Archive a bookmark to stop tracking the shipment.
